Project-authored fictional stack-using activated abilities V1. No real Magic or Oracle authority.
Reuse fictional draw-failure V1 turn windows, mana payment, priority passes, life/draw-loss checkpoints and ordered libraries.
The explicit stack_activation policy permits a selected uses_stack=true ability with the existing adjust_life/controller effect only.
Its timing is priority: the activator must have priority and control the known battlefield source. Unsupported restrictions or costs block.
Pay the declared supported mana cost and optional tap cost once. Create one typed activated_ability entry distinct from the source Card object. Do not apply the life effect at activation.
Entries have deterministic domain-separated identities bound to originating action, kind, source object, exact semantics, controller and ability ID. Spell entries reference their real spell Card on the stack; ability entries never fabricate a Card.
The activating player retains priority. Both players may respond using existing supported actions. Both must pass before exactly the top entry resolves, followed by the existing checkpoint and active-player priority.
Resolution adjusts the captured controller's life by the exact declared integer once and removes only that entry. The source remains in its battlefield zone with cost changes preserved.
This deliberately presence-pinned fictional rule requires the same known, identically controlled source and semantics on the battlefield until resolution. Source departure, controller/semantic changes or unknown interactions are unsupported; no last-known-information rule is invented.
No targets, triggers, countering, new effects, replacement/prevention, continuous effects, combat, real-Card admission or extra timing permissions are supported.
